contributions.detail: A TRACED +100.00 DELTA, retained verbatim, nothing nudged. Each sheet was gated on its OWN printed subtotal first. SHEET 2 (p3, 7 rows) CLOSES EXACTLY: 25 + 10 + 200 + 25 + 25 + 50 + 500 = 835.00 = its printed subtotal. SHEET 1 (p2, 15 rows) DOES NOT: 500 + 300 + 100 + 200 + 100 + 20 + 200 + 4,500 + 5,000 + 5,000 + 500 + 25 + 40 + 10 + 25 = 16,520.00 against a printed 'Subtotal for this page $16,620' — the rows fall 100.00 SHORT of the filer's own page subtotal. The 22 published rows therefore sum to 17,355.00 against a printed Box B of 17,455 (16,620 + 835 = 17,455, so the filer's grand total is internally consistent with his own two subtotals; the discrepancy is entirely inside sheet 1). WHAT WAS DONE BEFORE CALLING IT A DELTA (§H3): (a) the whole p2 amount column was re-rendered at 900 dpi in two overlapping block crops and every one of the 15 cells was re-read — $500, $300, $100, $200, $100, $20, $200, $4,500, $5,000, $5,000, $500, $25, $40, $10, $25 — with NO DOUBLED BAND anywhere: each printed band holds exactly one figure, so no entry was silently dropped; (b) the grid is a uniform 15-band grid and all 15 bands are used, so no banner, voided, continuation or skipped row shifts the index; (c) the one-past control was taken OUTSIDE the full grid (§J6) and rendered the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 16,620' rather than a figure, ruling out trap §F1.5 (a row written below the last rule); (d) every figure is born-digital machine type, so no glyph can absorb 100.00; (e) the CORRELATED-ERROR screen was run against this filer's OTHER 2022 filing (the 7/5/2022 Withdrawal report, already itemized in this wave): it closes EXACTLY on both sides with no comparable residue, so this is a one-off slip and not a filer habit. ATTRIBUTION IS NOT UNIQUE — the 100.00 could equally be a contribution the filer counted in his subtotal but never typed into a row, or a single typed row entered 100 low, and nothing on the page distinguishes them — so under §C5 NOTHING WAS CHANGED and the delta is retained as a fact about the document. Practical consequence for a reader: the itemized contribution side of this filing is a FLOOR of 17,355.00 against a stated 17,455.
